resource.name: Business Lookup
resource.description: The Business Lookup provides public information related to all current active accounts and five years of closed accounts for business licenses, excise tax accounts, and reseller permits issued by the Washington State Department of Revenue (DOR). It allows for search by business name, trade name, owners and officers, reseller permit number, unified business identifier (UBI), license number, street address, city, state, county, and endorsements issued through DOR's Business Licensing Service.

domain_metadata.value: This data set covers all active business license accounts regardless of first issuance date and recently closed business for a five-year window.

additional_access_points.description: Search tool for business lookups. Desktop format for computers with full size browsers.
additional_access_points.title: BLS Business Lookup

resource.name: Transient Accommodations (Lodging)
resource.description: Transient accommodations are facilities that offer three or more lodging units to guests for periods of less than thirty days. Facilities include hotels, motels, bed and breakfasts, resorts, inns, condominiums, crisis shelters, hostels, and retreats. The Washington State Department of Health licenses such facilities and  inspects them to ensure they meet state health and safety standards.

domain_metadata.value: The URL reflects the name of the database product used by the state Department of Health (healthspace.com), rather than the agency's domain (doh.wa.gov). The content is authoritative and maintained by the state Department of Health.

This database lists licensed facilities, and their address, facility ID, facility type, number of rooms, date of last inspection and recent inspection history. Contact the dataset owner only for clarification questions about this information. For additional information, please make a public records request: https://doh.wa.gov/about-us/public-records
More information about Transient Accommodations licensing: https://doh.wa.gov/licenses-permits-and-certificates/facilities-z/transient-accommodations-hotels-and-motels

additional_access_points.description: Transient accommodations include apartments, bed and breakfasts, condominiums, crisis shelters, hostels, hotels, inns, motels, resorts, retreats and rustic resorts.
additional_access_points.title: Transient Accommodations (Lodging) Facility Search

body.name: Permit Timeliness - Permit Application Processing Times (Washington State)
body.attribution: Governor's Office for Regulatory Innovation and Assistance (ORIA) (Washington State)
body.description: The Permit Timeliness dataset tracks how long it takes Washington State agencies to process permit applications. In 2014, state law RCW 43.42A was enacted to promote transparency and efficiency by requiring agencies to report permit processing times. Initially, the law covered 136 permits across 13 state agencies. As the program evolved, the number of permits and participating agencies changed. Each year, agencies reported how long it took to process permit applications during the previous calendar year. This data was collected and published by The Governor's Office for Regulatory Innovation and Assistance (ORIA) by March 1st. Alongside the data, progress reports summarized agency-reported information, identified trends in processing times, and described efforts to improve clarity, efficiency, and predictability in regulatory permitting. The final required report under RCW 43.42A was completed in 2020. To view the 2020 Permit Timeliness Progress Report, see https://www.oria.wa.gov/ORIA-2020-PermitTimelinessProgressReport.pdf. For earlier reports, visit https://www.oria.wa.gov/site/alias__oria/696/permit-timeliness.aspx. For detailed permit information and links to agency websites, explore the Regulatory Handbook: https://www.oria.wa.gov/site/alias__oria/403/regulatory-handbook.aspx.
body.queryString:
SELECT
  `permit_name`,
  `agency`,
  `year`,
  `receipt_to_complete_average`,
  `receipt_to_complete_maximum`,
  `complete_to_decision_average`,
  `complete_to_decision_maximum`,
  `extra_details`
WHERE
  (`receipt_to_complete_average` IS NOT NULL)
    OR ((`receipt_to_complete_maximum` IS NOT NULL)
          OR ((`complete_to_decision_average` IS NOT NULL)
                OR (`complete_to_decision_maximum` IS NOT NULL)))
ORDER BY
  `year` DESC NULL LAST,
  `agency` ASC NULL LAST,
  `permit_name` ASC NULL LAST

columns.name: Permit_Name
columns.description: Name of permit or instrument (NOTE: specific permit names may vary)

columns.name: Agency
columns.description: Name of reporting agency (NOTE: typically in commonly known/abbreviated form and could vary)

columns.name: Receipt_To_Complete_Average_(days)
columns.description: The average time elapsed [in days] from the initial submission of an application by an entity seeking a permit to the time at which the agency has determined that the application is complete (NOTE: blanks indicate aggregate not available)

columns.name: Receipt_To_Complete_Maximum_(days)
columns.description: The maximum time elapsed [in days] from the initial submission of an application by an entity seeking a permit to the time at which the agency has determined that the application is complete (NOTE: blanks indicate aggregate not available)

columns.name: Complete_To_Decision_Average_(days)
columns.description: The average time elapsed [in days] from receipt of a complete application to the agency's issuance of a decision approving or denying the permit (NOTE: blanks indicate aggregate not available)

columns.name: Complete_To_Decision_Maximum_(days)
columns.description: The maximum time elapsed [in days] from receipt of a complete application to the agency's issuance of a decision approving or denying the permit (NOTE: blanks indicate aggregate not available)

columns.name: Comments
columns.description: Any pertinent information relative to the data record

The Permit Timeliness dataset tracks how long it takes Washington State agencies to process permit applications. Established by state law in 2014, RCW 43.42A,  (https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx?cite=43.42A&full=true), the program was designed to improve transparency and efficiency by requiring agencies to report annual processing times. Initially covering 136 permits across 13 agencies, the scope evolved over time. Each year, agencies submitted data for the previous calendar year, which was published by the Governor's Office for Regulatory Innovation and Assistance (ORIA, https://www.oria.wa.gov) by March 1st. In addition to the data, progress reports (https://www.oria.wa.gov/site/alias__oria/400/Publications.aspx#anchor-2914) summarized trends, highlighted agency efforts, and described improvements in regulatory permitting. The final required report was completed in 2020 (https://www.oria.wa.gov/ORIA-2020-PermitTimelinessProgressReport.pdf).
Any questions regarding specific reported timeliness data should be directed to the associated agency.

metadata.rowLabel: Summarized permit application processing times for a specific permit-type reported by a specific state agency for a given calendar year
